The spell words can also be found at the official web site, at the ingame Spell List or on the [[Spells]] page. It looks the same as an [[Almanac of Magic]], [[Nature Magic Spellbook]] and [[Spellbook of Dragha]]. It has been made somewhat redundant by the [[Flash Client]]'s ability to list a character's known spells. Obtainable through the [[Elvenbane Quest]], [[Ornamented Shield Quest]] and daily spawn on the top of the [[Senja]] Castle.

history:
Before [[Updates/8.2]], spellbooks didn't have a defence value, and couldn't be used as a shield. Before [[Updates/8.5]], spellbooks had a weight of 58.00 oz, which has been significantly decreased.
* As announced on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8849|June 16, 2026}}, the [[Updates/15.25.3a4a52|Vocation Adjustments Update 2026]] raised its defense from 14 to 23

| notes         = Its inestimable value comes from its rarity and history. Also known as the ''Cyclopmania Sword'', ''Cyc Sword'' and ''Godslayer''. This sword is not available from any monster or quest in the game.

The in game legend says that, many years ago, the evil god [[Brog]] enslaved [[Cyclopes]] to smith weapons for his perilous armies. In secrecy, the smiths created this powerful weapon in order to commit mutiny against their captor. They failed at the task of slaying Brog, however he was heavily wounded. Filled with unspeakable rage he cast the sword down into the lands of Tibia to be lost forever. While buried in Brog's flesh, it became covered with his horrible blood, which hardened the blade and enchanted the ''Godslayer'' with unmatched power. However, a dark curse has been cast upon the blade causing its owner to become stricken with awesome madness and horrible luck. It is said nothing good can come to he who possesses the mystical blade.

| history       = The Magic Longsword first entered Tibia when Arieswar, Taghor and another very powerful person at that time were exploring the [[Plains of Havoc]] in search of a way to enter [[Knightwatch Tower]], with the knowledge that [[pick]]s would now open new holes. This was discovered by Taghor when, after an update, he went running around the areas surrounding [[Carlin]] and found a hole. He went down the hole and found [[Guido]] down there, who told him to go away. Taghor decided to return later only to find the hole no longer existed. Taghor began doing everything to the spot where the hole had been and eventually tried the pick.

After discovering the room currently known for containing the [[Ornamented Shield Quest]], they noticed a body under a [[fire field]]. Inside this body was a key to the Knightwatch Tower, a book, some assorted junk, and an item with a plain [[sword]] graphic. Upon further inspection of this sword, one-handed with attack 80 and defense 60, they soon realized just what they had stumbled upon. Taghor received a [[Magic Sword]] as compensation and attempts were made to keep this discovery quiet. Less than a week went by before Guido, furious that a map editor had hidden this weapon for himself, angrily demanded the weapon.

=== Second Discovery ===
The Magic Longsword was once again discovered, this time [[Arieswar]] found it in a killed [[Cyclops]]. Once again, this sword was also destroyed by [[CipSoft]] along with possibly other priceless items contained in Arieswar's depot.

=== Tibia Convention Award ===
The Magic Longsword finally resurfaced (with reduced stats of Atk: 55, Def: 40) and was awarded to {{character|Hagbard}} at the [[Tibia Convention 2001]] in Germany.

=== Auctions, sales, and robbery ===
* Hagbard decided to sell the sword, so he held an auction, which was won by {{character|Alex}} with a bid of 5.5 million gp.
* The sword was purchased for 5.5kk by Siobkerry, of Hokuten. 
* Siobkerry wanted to sell the sword for 7kk to Recca, but there was a problem. Tibia's first official war was going on, and it was {{Guild|Hokuten}}, vs. {{Guild|Satori}}, which was Recca's guild. Seeing as [[Safe Trade]] could not handle the amount of items necessary for this trade, it was decided that the only way the sword could be traded safely between these two enemies was for a middle man to do the trading. They called upon a renowned trader, Alex. Alex was only a lvl 20 druid, but he had been trading for so many years (before safe trade) that he was considered very trustable. There was one fatal flaw to Recca's plan, which was the key to Alex's plan... Alex was (secretly) also Strenni, a well known sorcerer who was a member of Hokuten. The trade went forward, with Siobkerry and Alex robbing all of the money from Recca, their enemy. The items could all be seen in the [[Dark Mansion]] for some time, as Hokuten was the original owner of it. This whole story has been since added to a book that can be found on the [[Isle of the Kings]] on books [[Legendary Curses VII.I (Book)]] and [[Legendary Curses VII.II (Book)]]
* It eventually belonged to {{Character|Moises the Dark}}, in [[Antica]].
* It got bought by {{Character|Rei de Lutabra}} around December, 2019, and was brought to [[Lutabra]].

=== Balancing ===
It was for a very long time the strongest non-throwable weapon in Tibia, besides the [[Ice Rapier]] which had 100 attack but would break in one hit. Later the Ice Rapier was changed to 60 attack, which was still stronger than the the Magic Longsword. Over the years, however, stronger weapons with additional attributes such as skill boosts and elemental damage were implemented, topping off the Magic Longsword.
}}

At the time, the next (and only) regular upgrade a sword-user could expect to attain was the rare [[Sword of Valor]]. It was easy to [[scam]] people in those days by offering a [[Two Handed Sword]] instead of a Giant Sword.

Its attack and defense values were changed from 50 and 20 to 46 and 22, respectively, with [[Updates/7.0|Update 7.0]].

It is one of the rarest items in the game, with only a few existing across all worlds.

* It used to have an attack value of 62 and a defense value of 40.

name: Great Axe
flavortext: A masterpiece of a dwarven smith.
history:
* Great Axes were the weapons of the dwarven kings. They were impossible to wield by any normal [[Dwarf]].
* For a very long time, this was considered the best and strongest [[Axe Weapons|axe]] in Tibia.
* There were only a few Great Axes in [[Tibia]]:
** One was given to {{character|Taghor}} as a reward from CipSoft for hosting the 2002 convention in Vienna, he gave it as a christmas gift to his friend {{character|Pytru}} but Pytru sold it to an unknown buyer in 2005.
** {{character|Mulf}}, {{character|Proxy}} and apparently {{character|Zamp}} had one Great Axe each, but they have been deleted.
** {{character|Yvonne}} won a Great Axe in the first tibian lottery ever.
* After [[Updates/8.4|Update 8.4]], [[Hellgorak]] was introduced and the Great Axe became easy to loot from him. After a patch, it was made rarer to loot. Nevertheless, the item became common to see in any world.
* The original image for this axe [[File:Great Axe (original).gif]] was replaced in the [[Updates/Update 8.0|Summer 2007 update]].

name: Thunder Hammer
flavortext: It is blessed by the gods of Tibia.
history:
* It was for a long time one of the best one-handed [[Club Weapons|Club Weapon]] available. * The first person in Tibia who looted it was {{Character|Elahrion Avessar}} ([[Elysia]]). * In the past, only three such hammers existed. ** One was rewarded on [[Eternia]] together with a [[Golden Helmet]] for reporting a security bug ** One was a gift from the gods to the person responsible for the 2002 real life convention. After Warrax's deletion, the hammer was sold. The buyer lost more then the hammer when he failed to heed the words from GM Flattery, losing his depot along with the hammer when CIP found him. * A Thunder Hammer existed on [[Premia]], entering through the Demon Quest that was located in today's [[Vampire Shield Quest]] that CipSoft created to get more people interested in Premia. The hammer was gained and sold by a Premian char named Morak. === World of Tibia Forum ==== The history of this hammer was best summed up by [[World of Tibia|WoT]]: Khundahamar, The Thunder Hammer
"In the times of dread some of the best dwarven smiths were hold captive by the forces of Blog. They were forced to teach the secrets of smithing to Blogs children, the cyclopses. Kazrad Rockfist, a dwarven hero, braved many dangers to find the hidden underground forges. He sneaked in and managed to free the captives, but as they made a run to the exit, they found the steel doors sealed shut. With the rampaging cyclopses of Blog in their back the dwarf begun to pray to their gods and in the last minute they got an answer from the heavens. Kazrads hammer became blessed, and with a single mighty hit the hero shattered the doors, allowing all captives to escape. Wielded in many battles as a symbol of the fight against the cyclopses, the hammer was lost. flavortext: It's the Helmet of Hermes.

Contrary to popular belief, this helmet has never granted speed, ultimate protection beyond its healthy defensive powers, or anything else.

This item is very rare, even though it was illegally duplicated a long time ago. There should be around 10 of these helmets existing, initially on [[Antica]].

history:

* In {{Auction|1788224|February 16, 2025}}, one of them was sold in [[Antica]] through the [[Character Auctions|bazaar]] for {{ilink|Tibia Coin}}217,626 [[Tibia Coins|TCs]].

* Initially, the shield had a defense rating of 50, which was reduced to 40 with [[Updates/7.0|Update 7.0]]. 
* Until [[Updates/11.80|Summer Update 2018]], it held the highest defense rating in the game.
* On June 15, 2022, the shield was sold via [[Market]] by Karr Chaos ({{Character|Nathquata}}) to {{Character|Rei de Lutabra}} for 12 billion [[Gold Coin]]s. Rei transferred the shield to [[Lutabra]] the following day.

Each fire bug can burn around 20 fields of sugar cane based on a test done by a player in which he bought 100 bugs and managed to burn 2011 fields. This item is also used in the [[Meriana Quest]], [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]], [[Treasure Hunt Quest]], [[Machinery of War Quest]], [[Tower Defence Quest]], [[Secret Service Quest]] (For TBI), [[Blood Brothers Quest]], and [[Kissing a Pig Quest]].

name: Slingshot
flavortext: A hermit near Carlin might be able to tell you more about it.
notes:
[[File:War Bear.gif|link=War Bear|right]] This is the item needed to tame a [[Bear]]. It has a chance of breaking when used. To buy this item, you need to have the rank of Huntsman or higher in the [[Paw and Fur Society]]. Players who choose to become a [[Paladin]] in [[Island of Destiny]] can see a slingshot in the associated cellar. Failed: {{Message|type=sound|The bear ran away.}}
Failed: {{Message|type=sound|The bear is trying to hit you with its claws.}}
Broken: {{Message|type=sound|Oh no! The slingshot broke.}}
Succeeded: {{Message|type=sound|You tamed the wild bear.}}
Most times the bear will either run away or try to hit you (when this happens the slingshot doesn't break).
history: Slingshot was implemented with [[Updates/7.8|Summer Update 2006]], but it was an [[Unobtainable Items|Unobtainable Item]] until [[Updates/8.7|Winter Update 2010]] when it was sold by NPC [[Grizzly Adams]] and dropped by [[Hunter]] (and could be used to tame [[War Bear]]). The price was supposed to be 100,000 gp, but due to a bug, players were able to get it for 34,463 gp, and CipSoft decided to keep it for approximately this price.

[[Milk]]
[[Oven]]
Any kind of [[Fruit]]
[[Knife (utensil)]]
[[Candlestick]]
1. Get the milk into a [[trough]] or [[bucket]].
2. Use flour with milk. You will get [[Lump of Cake Dough|cake dough]].

flavortext: Use it to learn how to make gingerbread in the christmas bakery.

notes:

[[Gingerbreadman|Gingerbreadmen]] can be made using a [[scythe]] to cut [[wheat]] from a [[wheat field]], grind it to [[flour]] in a mill, add [[milk]] with a [[trough]] or [[bucket]] to make [[Lump of Cake Dough]] and bake on an oven at the [[Christmas Bakery]] located in [[Vega]] under Santa's house.
Looks the same as [[Research Notes]], a [[Parchment (Poetry)]], a [[Parchment (Questionnaire)]], a [[Yellow Parchment]], and a [[Wrinkled Parchment]].

flavortext: If you can remove the rust layer and dirt from the armor you will be able to see what it is.
droppedby: {{Dropped By|Amenef the Burning|Annihilon|Empowered Glooth Horror|Ghastly Dragon|Grim Reaper|Hellgorak|Hellspawn|Horestis|Lost Soul|Madareth|Medusa|Metal Gargoyle|Plaguesmith|Professor Maxxen|Rustheap Golem|Soul of Dragonking Zyrtarch|The Abomination|Ushuriel|Zanakeph|Zorvorax|Zugurosh|Zulazza the Corruptor}}
notes:
Using a [[Rust Remover|rust remover]] on it will either '''break''' the armor or yield one of the following: * {{Ilink|Brass Armor}} [[Brass Armor]] (common) * {{Ilink|Plate Armor}} [[Plate Armor]] (uncommon) * {{Ilink|Knight Armor}} [[Knight Armor]] (uncommon) * {{Ilink|Crown Armor}} [[Crown Armor]] (semi-rare) * {{Ilink|Golden Armor}} [[Golden Armor]] (very rare) (See [[Slightly Rusted Armor/Unrusting Statistics|Unrusting Statistics]]). There is high chance that the armor will break. Use a [[Rust Remover|rust remover]] to un-rust the armor. This [[Rusty Armor]] gives the best chance of getting a rare item. It was initially thought that [[Magic Plate Armor]]s or [[Dragon Scale Mail]]s were also available by unrusting the armor, but this has proven to be false.
Successfully polishing this item will count towards the [[Polisher]] [[achievement]].
Getting a [[Golden Armor]] by successfully polishing this item is one of the two requirements to get the [[Lucky Devil]] [[achievement]].
notes2: '''Note:''' Rusted armors can be found in two additional variations, [[Heavily Rusted Armor]] and [[Rusted Armor]].
history:
In a small patch the weight was {{OfficialNewsArchive|1123|changed}} from 100.00 oz to 120.00 oz on November 10, 2009.
On {{OfficialNewsArchive|5087|June 12, 2019}}, its name was changed from ''Rusty Armor'' to the current one, and the sprite was also updated.

notes: [[Lucius]] can give you one during [[The Lightbearer]]. It will vanish at the end of November. Cannot be seen in the [[Market]].
history:
Was first seen in the 2 [[Test Server]]s preceding the first [[Lightbearer]] Event (the test servers of [[Updates/8.50|Summer Update 2009]] and [[Updates/8.53|Autumn Patch 2009]]).

==== Speed and shielding ====
On the test server of the Summer Update 2009, this item had a speed bonus of 50 and a defense value of 38. This was reduced (during that test server) to a speed bonus of 25 and a def of 25 because many testers agreed it could be abused. A defense value of 38 would mean a [[Shields|shield]] as strong as a [[Great Shield]] (dropped by Massacre, Morgaroth, Ferumbras and Ghazbaran) for free!

This item can also be used to cut [[Jungle Grass]] 100 times in order to gain the [[Nothing Can Stop Me]] achievement. Can also be used to cut fruit for [[Decorated Cake]]s in order to gain the [[Piece of Cake]] and [[With a Cherry on Top]] achievements.

| notes         = It can be obtained throughout and as reward of [[The Lightbearer]] event.

Can be traded for [[experience]] points with [[Lucius]] during and after succeeding in [[The Lightbearer]] event. A [[Game World]] that has failed the event can not exchange them. 

For each Midnight Shard, characters can gain <math>300 \cdot L</math> experience; L being the character's level. Note that the formula is not <math>\sum_{i=1}^{N} 300L_i</math> (for N shards), so if a character levels up by using one shard, they will gain 300 more experience per shard for the next level. Thus, it is slightly better to trade them incrementally than all at once. Check the [[Midnight Shard/Table|table]] for better results. 

A character can trade up to 80 shards for experience per year. However, an arbitrary amount of shards can be traded for gold.
| history       = ==== 2009 ====
Previously, the shards gave <math>30 \cdot L</math> experience and was also lootable from monsters on the good side of the [[Temple of Light]] if the event ends in success. The adjustment came as a result of the raising of the shards' rarity.

==== 2011 ====
During 2011, some players could trade up to 80 shards. Players who had not talked to Lucius yet after the {{OfficialNewsArchive|1892|November 12 patch}} could have their shard trade count reset after their next conversation with Lucius. For example, if one took 80 shards with them to Lucius, asked to trade all for experience, 40 would be traded; ending the conversation with 'bye' and repeating the process with the 40 remaining shards would allow the final 40 to be traded for experience. This was not a bug - it is the compensation for a bug in which some players could not trade 40 shards.

==== 2024 ====
{{OfficialNewsArchive|7987|The August 6 2024 patch}} increased the number of tradable shards from 40 to 80 and removed the level cap (of 200) for redeeming midnight shards.
}}

name: Piece of Marble Rock
flavortext: It seems just perfect to try and create something out of it with a sharp obsidian knife.
notes:
If you use an [[Obsidian Knife]] on it, you will either break it or carve one of the following: * [[File:Rough Marble Statue.gif]] [[Rough Marble Statue]] * [[File:Marble Statue.gif]] [[Marble Statue]] * [[File:Beautiful Marble Statue.gif]] [[Beautiful Marble Statue]] See a research article by [[Tibia-Stats]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20210509005650/http://www.tibia-stats.com/index.php?akcja=6003&research=sculpting here] to discover what the chances for getting each form of the marble statues are.

history: Before [[Updates/8.60|Update 8.60]], this item could only be looted rarely from [[Eternal Guardian]]s. With this update, however, [[achievements]] got introduced. Two of these were for sculpting [[Beautiful Marble Statue]]s, which only happens one in a hundred tries. As Eternal Guardians only spawned in the area that can only be accessed once a week for the [[Children of the Revolution Quest/Spoiler#Weekly Task: Zze Art of War|Zze Art of War]] task of the [[Children of the Revolution Quest]], these achievements would be nearly impossible to get if it stayed this way. That is why [[Chayenne]], after being made aware of this issue, added spawns of Eternal Guardians to [[Deeper Banuta]] and also added this item to the loot of [[Gargoyle]]s and [[Stone Golem]]s.

''Player'': hi
Edala: ''Player''. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.

5th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: Ashari, ''Player''. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.

6th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: ''Player''! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.

7th day:
{{Sound|}}
''Player'': hi
Edala: AAAARGH! ''Player''! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish '''diapason'''.}}

You can only use one stone per year per character and only when the [[Rise of Devovorga]] event is active (September 01–07) or before [[server save]] on September 30th, if your server successfully finished the event.

In case you want to know the experience difference gained from a level and another one (in case you decide to use the stone at the end of month to earn some extra experience), you can use the following formula:

<math>{ExpDiff} = 200\,\times\,{(CurrentLevel)}\,\times\,{(LevelsGained)}\,+\,100\,\times\,{(LevelsGained)}\,\times{(LevelsGained)}</math>

Reward of the [[Rise of Devovorga]] [[World Quest]], for characters who damaged [[Devovorga]] or one of its incarnations ([[Anmothra]], [[Irahsae]], [[Teneshpar]], [[Chikhaton]] or [[Phrodomo]]).

name: Boots of Homecoming
flavortext: They are made of dark red buckskin and the golden clasps look like the letter F.
notes:
When used inside of a [[Protection Zone|protection zone]], they will teleport you in front of the [[Ferumbras Citadel]] found {{Mapper Coords|125.121|127.196|7|4|text=here}} and the text will appear:
{{Sound|Magical sparks whirl around the boots and suddenly you are somewhere else.}}
If you do not meet the criteria to be able to [[Teleport|teleport]] using these boots, the message below will appear, accompanied by two graphical effects: red sparkles overlaid with an explosion effect, both displayed ontop your character.

The easiest method to confirm their readiness for teleportation (when not on cooldown) is to maintain them in a 'charged' state on your [[Action Bars|action bar]]. Alternatively, if not pre-set on an action bar, you can ascertain their charge by placing them in your depot and checking [[The Market (Object)|The Market]], as only boots that are charged can be sold on the market.

name: Ultimate Health Keg
objectclass: Plants, Animal Products, Food and Drink
flavortext: This keg can be used to refill ultimate health potions.
notes:
This item is available in the [[Store]] only. It fills up to 500 [[Ultimate Health Potion]]s. All potions created this way as well as the keg itself will be kept in [[Your Store Inbox]]. A keg is not only useful for providing potions in a hunting ground, it also saves you some capacity as its constant weight equals the net weight of 250 potions. The keg can only be used by the character who purchased it in the Store. For this reason, the potions filled using the keg need to fit the character's vocation and level. Once the keg is empty it will vanish into thin air.

name: Note About Two Souls
flavortext: Returning the amulet of the Cobra to its resting place has reversed everything that happened to Scarlett and Galthen after it was taken. For them only, however. You are truly selfless.
notes:
This item can be obtained by using [[The Cobra Amulet]] on an [[Intricate Cobra Shrine]] located inside a hidden crypt north of [[Ankrahmun]]. The crypt can be accessed by using a [[Shovel]] {{Mapper Coords|text=here|129.77|127.119|7|4|1|0.250.25}}. When this item was released, its creator [[Lionet]] {{post|38769695|explained}} what's behind its story:

:''I really appreciate the interest of the Tibia Community in our lore and stories! Here are some additional notes on my story of Scarlett and Galthen:''

:''The Cobra amulet is an extremely powerful artifact with an unknown origin as of now. Its traits are concentrated on a single individual but the curse will affect all things directly connected to the amulet and its wearer. When the amulet is returned to its eternal resting place, everything the taker, thus owner, of the amulet has experienced from that point in time onward will be undone. All of this, as already mentioned, will only affect events in direct relation to the bearer of the amulet and the bearer him- or herself.''

:''In the case of Scarlett and Galthen, Scarlett was blinded towards Galthen while in turn a successful search for Scarlett was impeded by the amulet. Returning it to its resting place will alter the timeline for Scarlett (and also Galthen who is directly connected to the Scarlett, the amulet and ultimately the curse). So in their world, the events after the crypt never took place. Everything before that will still have happened. However, without the power of the Cobra, Scarlett will not continue the assassin path much further and she, as well as Galthen, will have the possibility to find each other. Both their searches would eventually be successful as they belong together.''

:''By chosing to return the amulet, players are effectively building a somewhat happy ending for the two but will lose the amulet. That is why the note says: "You are truly selfless".''
history: This item could not be equipped as an amulet until [[Updates/12.20.9066|November 19, 2019]], when it was changed.

Succeeded: {{Message|type=sound|The white lion will now accompany you as a friend and ally.}}
